body:
It started at the hippie fest in a town located in WV, the All Good Festival.
The prices were rediculous.  I guess I should had expected this, due to the Japan cutting exports to the US.  It's definitely a precious commodity now.  Hard to believe a Schedule III is so difficult to obtain.
Anyway, a gram went for $100 the first day of the festival.  Then, as more people arrived, the economics of the festival got all John Nash and shit.
Bought 2 grams on the second day at $60 a piece.  Got to the stage, sat on the side of the mountain...and became ONE with it, literally.  A voice inside of my head, as usual, kept encouraging me to reason.  Symbols started appearing on the ground.  Mine are usually binary 1's and 0's...but this time they were Celtic.  My teeth became brittle feeling, as did my body.  Almost robotic.  Typical experience that I love.
I must admit, it's difficult to speak coherently while indulging in this spice.  The lasting effects are real, but temporary if one doesn't over do it.  As usual, the next day my speech was a bit slurred, but it was well worth it.  Wonderful experience!
